[RDSC.1.2] An atom is an independently parseable record: one entry of the
container's `body` oneof, framed `[oneof_tag][varint len][body]`, and **its
field number is its identity** ([RFCS.16.1], [RFCS.19.1]). An atom's name is
its body message, the `Atom` column of [RDSC.7.1]; no name appears on the
wire.
